title: Interior trends 2026: what tile has to offer
excerpt: Natural textures, calm colours and large formats are the main directions in interior design for 2026. How to find them in the CROWN, ITALICA and TORRA collections.
body:
At the start of the year, drawing on conversations with designers and clients, we identified several directions gaining strength in 2026 interiors. They complement each other and share one idea: naturalness and calm.

The first direction is surfaces that echo natural materials. Tiles with marble, limestone or travertine looks are valued for a pattern as unique as real stone. CROWN collections answer exactly this demand.

The second is large format. Tiles of 600×1200 and above create a quiet surface with minimal joints. The ITALICA brand specialises in large formats with concrete and terrazzo looks.

The third is accent through colour and texture. One wall or one zone is set apart with bold or relief tile. TORRA collections are made for such accents.

The fourth is using one material on floor and walls. This makes the space feel whole and is especially useful in small rooms.

Samples for every direction can be seen in our showroom and matched to your project.
